caption: The drawing depicts a lantern with a cylindrical, perforated metal top, a domed lid, and a large circular handle affixed at the top by a bracket. The body of the lantern is rectangular and constructed of two hinged doors, each consisting of dark green panels framed with brownish-bronze edges. Each panel is horizontally reinforced with three evenly spaced metal bars. The lantern's surfaces display a patina of green and brown hues, indicative of aged metal. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or decoration. The lantern is centered and takes up most of the vertical space in the composition.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
